notes: Runs on a bare Next.js scaffold (package.json + app/) with no prisma yet. Nearly all assertions are machine-checkable via scripts/verify.mjs. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.

evals.name: fresh-project-new-database
evals.prompt: โปรเจค asset-register ยังไม่มี database เลยครับ ต่อ sql server ให้ด้วย server อยู่ที่ 10.10.1.25 port 1433 database ชื่อ AssetRegister สร้างใหม่ ยังไม่ต้องใช้ stored procedure
evals.expected_output: Installs prisma + mssql adapter + t3-env · prisma.config.ts holds the url · schema skeleton per convention · committable .env.example plus uncommitted .env.local · no direct process.env reads
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-database-setup exits 0
prisma.config.ts has the url and prisma/schema.prisma has no url in its datasource
The generator in schema.prisma uses provider = "prisma-client-js"
lib/prisma.ts uses a type-only import for mssql, not a value import
lib/env.ts is the only file reading process.env (root *.config.ts excepted)
Every model has PascalCase-plural @@map and every field has @map
Every app-owned model carries all 7 audit columns
.env.example holds no real password (placeholders only) and .gitignore covers .env.local
No __DB_HOST__ __DB_PORT__ __DB_NAME__ placeholders left in .env.local
No leftover comments referencing __EXT___ or __LINKED_SERVER__, since this project uses neither

evals.name: existing-db-with-sp-and-linked-server
evals.prompt: ต่อ prisma ให้โปรเจค hr-report กับ database ที่มีอยู่แล้วชื่อ HRReport ที่ 10.10.1.30 นะ ต้องเรียก stored procedure ที่ชื่อ usp_RebuildMonthlySummary ด้วย แล้วมีอ่านข้อมูลพนักงานข้าม linked server ชื่อ HRLINK มาด้วย
evals.expected_output: Uses the introspect/migrate-resolve path for an existing DB · sets requestTimeout for long SPs · calls the SP via a $executeRaw tagged template · linked server stays SELECT-only with CAST on every column
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-database-setup exits 0
Does not run schema-creating prisma migrate dev against a database that already holds data
lib/prisma.ts sets requestTimeout above the 15-second default
Stored-procedure calls use $executeRaw tagged templates, not $executeRawUnsafe
Linked-server reads use the full 4-part name and CAST every selected column
No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statements target the linked server
Functions taking user input sanitize with a regex first, then parameterize

evals.name: reserved-word-column-must-be-renamed
evals.prompt: เพิ่มตารางเก็บ config ของแอปให้ด้วย มีคอลัมน์ key, value, group แล้วก็ order สำหรับเรียงลำดับ
evals.expected_output: Fulfills the request but renames the T-SQL-reserved columns by adding qualifiers (SettingKey/SettingValue/GroupName/SortOrder) with annotating comments, and includes the full audit columns
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-database-setup exits 0
No column maps literally to Key, Value, Group, or Order
Replacement names carry qualifiers, e.g. SettingKey / SettingValue / GroupName / SortOrder
Schema comments annotate the reserved-word workarounds
The new table has full audit columns and a PascalCase-plural @@map
Explains to the user why the columns were renamed rather than changing them silently

evals.name: migrate-prototype-sqlite-store-behind-same-signatures
evals.prompt: ต่อ SQL Server ให้โปรเจคนี้ด้วยครับ ตอนนี้ข้อมูลอยู่ใน sqlite ที่ ai studio สร้างไว้ ย้ายมาด้วยเลย แต่หน้าเว็บกับการทำงานเดิมห้ามพัง
evals.setup: Run on a copy of ../../ugt-nextjs-full-setup/evals/fixtures/ai-studio-prototype (shared fixture — see its README). services/requests.ts opens data/app.db with better-sqlite3, seeds from data/seed.json, and exports listRequests / createRequest / updateStatus that app/page.tsx and app/requests/page.tsx call. Under test is SKILL §4b: the 2026-09-09 field bug was Prisma installed BESIDE the SQLite store with every screen still reading SQLite, and verify passing green.
evals.expected_output: Installs Prisma + SQL Server per §1–§4, then §4b: inventory table first (entity Requests · store better-sqlite3/data/app.db · read paths page.tsx + requests/page.tsx · write paths createRequest/updateStatus · seed rows) → Requests model per conventions → the three exported functions keep their names and signatures with bodies on @/lib/prisma → seed decision recorded → better-sqlite3, data/app.db, seed.json removed → decisions.md updated → verify exits 0 with the prototype-store check passing
assertions: An inventory table (entity · where stored · read paths · write paths · sample rows worth keeping) is presented before any schema or code is written

prisma/schema.prisma has a `request` model with @@map("Requests"), @map on every column, the full audit set (Id/CreatedAt/UpdatedAt/CreatedBy/UpdatedBy/IsActive/IsDeleted), status as String @db.NVarChar(20) (no DB enum), and no reserved-word column

services/requests.ts still exports listRequests, createRequest and updateStatus with the same signatures and return shapes; their bodies use @/lib/prisma; app/page.tsx and app/requests/page.tsx were not rewritten to a different API
listRequests filters isDeleted: false and updateStatus does not hard-delete anything
The seed decision is explicit: either scripts/seed-from-prototype.ts imports data/seed.json once (idempotent), or the rows are dropped — and the choice is written to docs/project-context/decisions.md

better-sqlite3 (and @types/better-sqlite3) are removed from package.json; data/app.db is deleted; next.config.ts no longer lists better-sqlite3 in serverExternalPackages; no file imports better-sqlite3
docs/project-context/decisions.md records the entity map (requests → Requests), any renamed/dropped fields, and the seed decision with today's date

node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-database-setup exits 0 — 'No prototype data store left beside Prisma/SQL Server' passes and 'Feature code actually reads through @/lib/prisma' reports files, not a warning
The closing summary says which store the screens now read; it never reports 'ต่อ database แล้ว' while services/requests.ts still opens SQLite
